Agent Name: Orchestrator
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Orchestrator failed to verify the completeness of the data retrieved by WebSurfer before proceeding. In Step 1, WebSurfer only captured 26% of the Bing search results page, which was insufficient to gather a comprehensive list of Ted Danson's TV series. Despite this, the Orchestrator updated its ledger and instructed WebSurfer to continue searching without acknowledging the incomplete data. This premature assumption of progress led to a cycle of repetitive, ineffective searches and ultimately resulted in an incorrect final answer ("CSI Cyber") because the necessary data to compare Rotten Tomatoes ratings for all eligible series was never fully collected.
